_note: Artwork registry. Every image on the site is referenced from here so the alt text and the artist credit stay consistent. 'credit' must name the human artist who drew the piece. Source files came from the fury-arts drive folder supplied by the Refpaw owner; confirm the credit line and the permission to display each piece before launch.
